name: Souls

members.name: Nakib Khan
members.role: Former member (joined after founder Lulu's departure, 1972)

global_influences.evidence: Souls began performing cover songs of Western bands in Chittagong/Dhaka hotels in the early 1970s before shifting to original compositions, directly transmitting Western rock/pop conventions into the emerging Bangladeshi band scene.
global_influences.source: Wikipedia Souls (band); Band Music of Bangladesh profile

local_adaptation_notes: Formed in 1972 (originally as Shurela, renamed Souls in 1973) in the immediate post-Liberation period, Souls is among the very first generation of Bangladeshi bands to transition from hotel-circuit Western cover performance to original Bangla and English songwriting, functioning as a foundational training ground — the band's alumni (Ayub Bachchu, Nakib Khan, Pilu Khan, Tapan Chowdhury) went on to found or join other pivotal acts (notably LRB), making Souls a key node in the genealogy of Bangladeshi mainstream rock.
sound_evolution_summary: Founding period (1972–1970s): formed in Chittagong shortly after independence, performing Western covers in hotel venues while developing original material; multiple formative lineup changes brought in future rock icons. Breakthrough period (1980s): debut album Super Souls (1980) followed by Colleger Corridore (1982), Manush Matir Kachakachi (1987) and East & West (1988) established the band within the pop-rock/blues-rock mainstream. Later period: continued output through 2011's Jam album, reflecting one of the longest active tenures in Bangladeshi rock history.
concert_culture_notes: Rooted in Bangladesh's earliest hotel-circuit live music culture (e.g., InterContinental-style venues) before the band-based concert/festival circuit matured, reflecting the transitional performance economy of 1970s Dhaka/Chittagong.
listener_community_notes: Regarded as one of the oldest and most foundational Bangladeshi rock/pop bands, with a listener base spanning the earliest cassette-era rock audiences through to later generations who encounter the band via its alumni's more famous later projects (LRB).

sources.title: SOULS — One of The Oldest Pop Bands in Bangladesh — Band Music of Bangladesh
